2. What we offer

WishCraft lets you create personalised animated digital greeting cards for birthdays, proposals, anniversaries and other occasions. A card can contain names, a message, photos and music.

  • Preview is free. You can create and preview a card as many times as you like without paying.
  • Sharing costs ₹35 per card. After payment you get a unique link that you can send to anyone.
  • The card is a digital product. Nothing physical is shipped.

3. Prices and payment

  • All prices are in Indian Rupees (INR) and include any applicable taxes.
  • Payments are processed securely by Razorpay (UPI, debit/credit cards, netbanking, wallets). We never see or store your card number, CVV, UPI PIN or bank passwords.
  • Your card's link is activated only after Razorpay confirms the payment.
  • We may change prices in the future. The price shown at the time you pay is the price you pay.

4. Delivery

Your card link is delivered instantly on screen after a successful payment. See our Shipping & Delivery Policy.

5. Refunds and cancellation

Because cards are digital and delivered instantly, payments are generally non-refundable, except in the cases listed in our Refund & Cancellation Policy.

6. Your content

You are responsible for everything you put in a card: names, messages, photos, captions and songs. By uploading content you confirm that:

  • you own it or have permission to use it, including any music you upload;
  • people shown in your photos are okay with being included;

You keep ownership of your content. You give us a limited permission to store, process and display it only to create and show your card to people who have its link.

We may remove a card that breaks these rules or the law. If a card is removed for breaking these rules, no refund is given.

You agree not to:

8. Who can see your card

Anyone who has your card's link can open it. Links are random and hard to guess, but if you share a link publicly, anyone can view the card. Please share it only with the people you intend to.

9. How long cards stay available

We intend to keep paid cards available for at least 12 months from the date of payment. After that, cards may be deleted. You can ask us to delete your card sooner (see our Privacy Policy).
